name: @aiappfactory/security-gate
description: Runs the T1/T2 gate set over an App Spec (02_SECURITY §4.2) and hands the resulting findings to @aiappfactory/risk-engine for a signed verdict. Gate 0 (structural validation) already does most of the work for this generation tier by construction (ADR-001) — this package adds Gate 2 (secret patterns) and a Gate 6 heuristic (under-classified PII), the two gates cheap enough to run with no external services.
